name: Hapisama! - Prelude -
source:
Happy Summer! is a coming-of-age school romance visual novel starring a second-year high school boy and nine heroines.

Happy Summer! – Prelude is a ~5-minute side story that offers a small taste of the world.

[from [url=https://carrottown.itch.io/happy-summer-prelude-en]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夏天快乐！是一部青春校园浪漫视觉小说，由一名高中二年级男生和九名女主角主演。

夏天快乐！– Prelude是一个约5分钟的支线故事，提供了对这个世界的小小品味。
